usedFor: Teams use Linkup to put a question to it with “Get an answer to your question” and pass the answer on, for example into a Monday email or a sheet.

bestTemplate.name: “Get an answer to your question” in Linkup
bestTemplate.why: It is Linkup’s one action: you give it a question, and the answer comes back for the next step to use.

watchOut: Linkup has no trigger, so a schedule or another app’s event has to start it, and the question must be written into the step.
